text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today marks the third of the Classic
races—the
Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
For a while, it was looking like I wasn't
even
gonna be able to enter...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
But I made it! I'm finally at the Kikuka
Sho!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Looks like all our efforts were
worth it,
huh, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All right, I need to get pumped up! I
came here to
show them what I'm made
of!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yep, I will! The third of those crowns is
gonna be
mine for sure, you wait and
see!
choice_data_list: 思いっきり走ってこい！
思いっきり走ってきて！
